name: @redemeine/projection-service
description: Single-node projection worker with trusted application definition bundle input

scripts.build: tsup && node scripts/seal-artifact.mjs && tsup --config tsup.worker.config.ts && node scripts/seal-artifact.mjs dist-worker && node scripts/worker-notices.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build:test-host && pnpm run build:integration && pnpm run build:application-example && pnpm exec jest --config ../../jest.config.js --roots packages/projection-service/test --runInBand
